requirements.text: System must verify user login credentials
System must generate a JWT token after successful login
System must verify JWT token expiry
System must lock account after five failed login attempts
System must log all login attempts to the audit log
System must support password reset via email

code_entities.name: verify_credentials

code_entities.docstring: Check whether JWT token has expired
